title: Hand Reveal
description: Uses the tracked hand and its motion trail to reveal Source B through Source A.

parameters.label: Reveal
parameters.description: Amount of Source B revealed by the tracked hand.

parameters.label: Reveal Size
parameters.description: Width of the reveal around the hand structure.

parameters.label: Trail Reveal

parameters.label: Outline
parameters.description: Brightness of the tracked hand outline.

parameters.label: Outline Colour
parameters.description: Colour of the tracked hand outline.
